name: lookup_address
description: Look up the last recorded status of an address. Call once you have the person's full name and their address.

address.description: House number and street, digits not words, e.g. '1420 Sunset Mesa Dr'.

subject_name.description: First and last name of the person the caller is asking about.

caller_state.description: Your read of the caller from everything they have said so far. worried = normal concern for someone they cannot reach. distressed = crying, pleading, struggling to answer. panicked = frantic, cannot think straight, screaming.

name: log_call
description: Log the call and get the routing decision. Call after lookup_address, or immediately if the caller is with the person now.

with_them_now.description: True if the caller is physically with the person right now.

emergency.description: True if there is any sign of a first-hand emergency.

caller_update.description: Newer information from the caller that the record may not have, e.g. 'he texted 20 minutes ago, still at home'.

last_contact_hours.description: Routine mode: hours since the caller last heard from them.

mobility.description: True if they have trouble getting around.

caller_state.description: Your read of the caller from everything they have said so far. worried = normal concern for someone they cannot reach. distressed = crying, pleading, struggling to answer. panicked = frantic, cannot think straight, screaming.

reported_status.description: Only if the caller has newer first- or second-hand information on where the person is: staying = still at the address / refusing to leave; out = has left the area. Omit if unknown.

reported_by.description: resident = the caller IS the person who lives at the address, calling about themselves.

reported_minutes_ago.description: How old that information is, in minutes ("he texted 20 minutes ago" = 20). 0 if the caller is telling you right now.

name: request_human
description: Call immediately if anyone is injured, trapped, or in immediate danger, or the caller asks for a person. Then call transfer_to_human.

reason.description: A few words: what the caller said that made this urgent.

name: transfer_to_human
description: Transfer the caller to a human call-taker.

private_handoff_option.prompt: In one short sentence, tell the call-taker who the caller is asking about, the address if known, and why the call was transferred. Do not greet.

name: end_call
description: End the call only after log_call has run, nobody is in danger, and the caller has nothing else.
